relationships.subject: GABA
relationships.evidence_quote: GABA depolarized sural nerve axons and increased the electrical excitability of C-fibres via GABA<sub>A</sub> receptor.

relationships.subject: NKCC1
relationships.evidence_quote: NKCC1 maintains intra-axonal chloride to provide feed-forward stabilization of C-fibre excitability and thus support sustained firing.

relationships.subject: GABAA receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: ADS was reduced by GABA<sub>A</sub> R agonists and exacerbated by either GABA<sub>A</sub> R antagonists, β3 deletion or NKCC1 blockade.

relationships.subject: NKCC1
relationships.evidence_quote: ADS was reduced by GABA<sub>A</sub> R agonists and exacerbated by either GABA<sub>A</sub> R antagonists, β3 deletion or NKCC1 blockade.

key_findings: GABA depolarized peripheral C-fibre axons and increased their excitability via GABAA receptors (absent with DRG-specific β3 deletion).
NKCC1 maintains intra-axonal chloride so GABAA activation stabilizes C-fibre excitability during sustained firing (reduces ADS).
